images.title: Two friends, one bracket
images.purpose: Show that two identical orders make 2 × (43 + 24), which is 2 × 43 + 2 × 24.
images.composition: Two identical trays side by side, a bracket over one tray, and the equation below.
exact_structure: Two identical rounded rectangles (trays) side by side, each containing a teal #0072B2 rectangle labelled ₹43 and an amber #E69F00 rectangle labelled ₹24.
A reddish purple #CC79A7 bracket over the first tray only, labelled 43 + 24.
A label 2 × to the left of the pair of trays.
images.takeaway: A number outside the bracket multiplies each term inside it.
images.description: Two identical trays each with ₹43 and ₹24, written as 2 × (43 + 24) and as 2 × 43 + 2 × 24.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text on multiplying a bracket.
images.teaching_notes: Count the ₹43 pieces and the ₹24 pieces across both trays.

image_decisions.why: Two identical orders show how the multiplier shares across both terms.
